products.title: Shoesy Shoe Cabinet
products.description: Well-made, great-looking and super comfortable. Our Walker outdoor collection is a customer favorite that checks all the boxes. Built to stand up to the elements, the dining table and chair set is made of rustproof aluminum treated with a durable matte powdercoat finish. Foam-filled seat cushions upholstered in your color choice of stain-resistant Sunbrella fabric layer on comfort.

products.title: Modern Armchair
products.description: A modern classic armchair upholstered in premium beige fabric. Features solid wood legs and high-density foam cushioning for all-day comfort. Perfect for living rooms and reading nooks.

products.title: Wooden Dresser with Tri-fold Mirror
products.description: Elegant wooden dresser with a classic tri-fold mirror. Features 6 spacious drawers with dovetail joinery and smooth-glide hardware. Crafted from solid mango wood with a rich walnut finish.

products.title: 3-Seater Linen Sofa with Cushions
products.description: Sink into this cloud-like 3-seater sofa upholstered in premium linen blend fabric. Deep seats, plush back cushions and solid kiln-dried wood frame make this sofa as durable as it is beautiful.

products.title: Mid-Century Lounge Chair with Ottoman
products.description: A timeless mid-century design featuring a sculptural wooden base and generously padded seat and back. Includes matching ottoman. Perfect for any modern living space.

products.title: Round collapsible dining table
products.description: Solid oak coffee table with clean lines and a natural finish. Features a lower shelf for additional storage. Sustainably sourced wood with a water-resistant coating.

products.title: King Size Platform Bed Frame
products.description: Modern platform bed with an upholstered headboard and solid wood slat system. No box spring needed. Features a low-profile design with clean geometric lines.

products.title: MK Krosses shelving
products.description: Minimalist floating wall shelf with invisible mounting hardware. Crafted from engineered wood with a lacquered finish. Ideal for books, plants and decorative objects.

products.title: Minimal Office Work Desk
products.description: Compact minimalist office desk designed for productivity. Clean surface, cable management system, and durable wood finish.

products.title: Modern TV Stand with Storage
products.description: Stylish TV stand with spacious storage compartments and cable management. Perfect for modern living rooms.
